description: NTP4VC: verification conditions (VCs) generated by Why3 from program verification tasks (algorithm pearls, Frama-C / airborne safety code), exported as standalone proof obligations in Isabelle, Rocq, and Lean 4. Unlike miniF2F/PutnamBench, these are software verification goals, not competition math.

isabelle.name: Isabelle/HOL
isabelle.note: one .thy file per VC; filenames encode the Why3 goal ID

lean4.name: Lean 4
lean4.note: lean_standalone variant: self-contained files that do not require the Why3 Lean library

categories.frama_c: Frama-C verified C programs (airborne safety code)
